record.field:
Search for records in an Odoo model using an Odoo domain.
Use this tool when you need to find records matching specific conditions. The model parameter must be the technical Odoo model name, such as 'res.partner', 'sale.order', or 'account.move'...etc
The domain is a list of search conditions. Each condition has the format: [field_name, operator, value]
The tool returns the IDs of matching records. Use the limit parameter to control the maximum number of results and offset for pagination. Use order to specify the sort order.
Do not invent field names. Only use fields that exist on the specified Odoo model.

model_name = args.get('model') limit = args.get('limit') or None domain = args.get('domain')
record_ids = env[model_name].search(domain, limit=limit) result = record_ids.ids
Technical name of the Odoo model, for example 'res.partner'.

Odoo search domain used to filter records.
A domain is a list of conditions. Each condition has the format: [field_name, operator, value]
Maximum number of records to return.
Odoo sort order, for example 'name asc'.
